notes.title: 20240704 Update
notes.content:
Bug fix: Returning to the stronghold after a battle and entering the H-scene again will cause the game to be unable to proceed.

notes.title: 2024/06/04 Update
notes.content:
Bug fix 1: In the preparation scene, pressing [M] key will result in failure to open [Set Armory].
Bug fix 2: In the preparation scene, pressing the [Y] key will cause the weapon to be discarded.
Bug fix 3: Missing skill descriptions in [Ability Status].
Bug fix 4: Subtitles in H-scene have been corrected by humans (Chinese/Japanese/English).
Bug fix 5: Certain weapons will cause the player to reach the maximum amount of crystals they can hold.
Change 1: Ammo packs and first aid kits are now automatically used when picked up and cannot be stockpiled in inventory.
Change 2: In H-scene, the [Toggle Camera] and [Exit H-scene] buttons have been relocated.
Added 1: Supported PS and Xbox series game grips.
Added 2: [?] Help button adds instructions for joystick manipulation, and UI symbols correspond to the hints.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: 2024/01/19 Update
notes.content:
1. Update: Mega Energy now has a more noticeable alert effect.
2. Update: The Meatball Blessing item can be filled with Mega Energy at the beginning of the game.
3. Fixed: Can't bring back the weapons obtained in the game to the base.
4. Fixed: Cannot enter H mode after returning to the base.

notes.title: 2024/01/16 Updated
notes.content:
1. Fixed: In SFW mode, zombie girls and bunny girls still show their breasts.
2. Fixed: When the MG falls to the ground, the player will pause the game and go back to the base.
When the MG is down, the player will pause the game and return to the base point, and then the next battle will cause the MG to ignore the player's attack hardness.
3. Added: keyboard mouse control instructions (mandatory once).
4. Fixed: Player transformation animation camera error.
5. Fixed: Rabbit's sight icon is not displayed correctly.
6. Fixed the bug that MG would get stuck when switching too fast on the level selection screen.
7. Update: The attack power of gigantic players is now related to the attack power of normal-sized players.
8. Fixed: When MG falls to the ground, the player will pause the game and go back to the base.
When MG falls to the ground, after the player pauses the game and returns to the base, the next battle will cause the MG to ignore the player's attack hardening.

notes.title: 2024/01/12 Update
notes.content:
1. New Dodge function has been added.
Now the giant girl won't keep chasing you.
As long as you avoid her line of sight and stay away from her for a while, she will give up.

2. Fixed the phenomenon that building explosions can produce too much popping sound at once.
3. Fixed the problem that the BGM will be invalid after playing once.
4. Added the appearance of the player in the "Freedom Set".
5. Added the ability to change the background music (MP3).

To change or add background music, please close the game first.
Put the MP3 file into the folder at the following path in the game directory.
Mega Hero\Mega Hero_Data\StreamingAssets\MP3
The game will automatically grab the files that match the type.
It will be played automatically (sorted by name) when the player is a free man.
*Use the [<] and [>] buttons to switch tracks, or [/] to play at random.

notes.title: 2023/12/23 Update
notes.content:
1. Enhance the sense of impact and improve the judgment of attack.
2. The Explosive Flying Kick can't change direction after launching.
3. Increase the back jump to avoid attacks (Shift+S).
4. Increase MG's attack tips (blue light can be invoked, red light can only be avoided).
5. Changed some visual effects and sound effects.
6. Enhanced the visual effect of building damage.
7. Now you can get some rewards for destroying buildings.
8.Now you don't need to wait for the victory screen to get rewards for destroying MG's clothes.
